stem.text: An emergency vehicle sounds its siren as it accelerates along a straight road between two points X and Y, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of a road between two circles labelled X and Y, with a vehicle on the road, an arrow labelled direction of travel, and the labels road and emergency vehicle.

stem.text: The frequency of the sound emitted by the siren is $750\,\text{Hz}$.
A person stands at X and another person stands at Y.
What describes the sounds heard by the people at X and at Y as the vehicle accelerates?

A.text: higher than $750\,\text{Hz}$, increasing in frequency; lower than $750\,\text{Hz}$, decreasing in frequency

B.text: higher than $750\,\text{Hz}$, decreasing in frequency; lower than $750\,\text{Hz}$, increasing in frequency

C.text: lower than $750\,\text{Hz}$, decreasing in frequency; higher than $750\,\text{Hz}$, increasing in frequency

D.text: lower than $750\,\text{Hz}$, increasing in frequency; higher than $750\,\text{Hz}$, decreasing in frequency

columns: sound heard by person at X
sound heard by person at Y
